modules.name: My Tasks
modules.description: A view where an assigned person sees and works on the complaints assigned to them.

modules.name: Complaint Resolution
modules.description: Handling of work status updates on a complaint, from Work Started to Fixed, with resident approval.

requirements.title: Show assigned person only own complaints
requirements.description: When the assigned person opens My Tasks, the system shows only the complaints assigned to that person.

requirements.title: Mark Work Started and Fixed with photo
requirements.description: The assigned person can mark a complaint as Work Started and then as Fixed, attaching a photo when marking it Fixed.

requirements.title: Notify resident for approval when fixed
requirements.description: When a complaint is marked Fixed, the system notifies the resident so they can approve the fix.

rules.title: Alert senior when time limit crossed
rules.description: If the time limit for fixing a complaint is crossed, the system alerts a senior.
